description: This file defines the ContentService interface for content management operations within a CMS, including methods for adding, removing, and retrieving content and associated files for merchant stores.

classes.name: ContentService
classes.description: Interface defining methods responsible for content management, including CRUD operations for content and content files related to merchant stores.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieve list of Content items by specific ContentType for a merchant store and language.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieve list of Content items for multiple ContentTypes for a merchant store and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetch a Content object by its code for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persist new or updated Content object.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetch a Content object by code, store, and language.

methods.name: addContentFile
methods.description: Store a content file (e.g., image) for a merchant store.

methods.name: addContentFiles
methods.description: Store multiple content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Remove a specific content file by name and content type from a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Remove all content files associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFile
methods.description: Retrieve a specific content file by name and content type for a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFiles
methods.description: List all content files of a certain type for a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFilesNames
methods.description: Get list of file names for content files of a specific type for a merchant store.

methods.name: addLogo
methods.description: Add a store logo image for a merchant store.

methods.name: addOptionImage
methods.description: Add an option image for merchant store content.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: List Content entities by types for a merchant store.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: List names of Content entities by types for a merchant store in a specific language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieve Content by ID and language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Fetch ContentDescription by store and SEO URL.
